overlap_details: No text, annotations, or labels overlap or appear clipped.
issues: The orange highlight is visually strong but its meaning is not explicitly encoded by a legend or label.
White text on the medium-gray bars has only moderate contrast and may be less readable at smaller print sizes.
The figure uses a large amount of empty space on the right, making the composition feel unbalanced.
The black bar outlines are relatively heavy compared with the otherwise minimal styling.
The title is long and editorial in tone; the parenthetical retraction note dominates attention and is not typical of a polished publication figure.
There are no axes or ticks, so axis-label assessment is not applicable.
suggestions: Use dark text on the gray bars or darken the gray fill to improve contrast.
Adopt a colorblind-safe accent such as blue or vermilion and clarify what the highlighted row signifies.
Reduce the canvas width or move the right-side outcome labels closer to the bars.
Use thinner, softer bar borders for a cleaner appearance.
Shorten the title and move the correction or retraction explanation into the caption.
Align row labels and outcomes to a more explicit two-column grid with consistent spacing.
